title: Fall from open cargo door or unprotected loading platform
trigger_or_cause: Open door, unseen drop or unprotected recovery with the platform elevated
consequence: Physical injury and severe equipment damage
proposed_control: Use secured doors or approved physical capture/barrier. Guard elevated work; plan retrieval and require verified braking margin.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Guarded worst-case stopping and safety procedure signed; residual exposure during loading/retrieval reviewed by site safety.

title: Optical range common-cause failure or blind swivel
trigger_or_cause: Dark or wet boards, frost, specular metal, overhanging head, sideways corner sweep
proposed_control: Combine angled look-ahead and close-range protection, quality/stale checks, speed limits, bumper and independent restraint.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Direction-specific invalid-return and diagonal/pivot test records, inspect footprints and physical catch for each permitted direction.

title: Unexpected restart or ineffective mode-specific protection
trigger_or_cause: Loss of a required protective or supervisory link, entry into a secured unattended survey, unexpected restart, brownout or intrusion into a moving protective envelope.
proposed_control: Enforce the selected mode locally. Secure access for an empty unattended run. In shared-space operation stop on protective-envelope intrusion or fault and isolate drive for close work. Require deliberate rearm and a fresh movement request.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Witnessed mode change at rest, protection/link-loss, field clearing, reset, recovery and inhibited-command trials.

title: Drive skid, caster hang or incline rollback
trigger_or_cause: Dust/ice, threshold or lack of power-off hold; payload shifts support polygon
consequence: Stopping distance exceeded or damaged entrance film
proposed_control: Measure floor adhesion and contact limits, limit speed/slope, protect window and add power-off holding solution where necessary.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Measured maximum-mass stop, dropout, slope and seam tests across approved floor types with positive margin.

title: Overstated coverage from segment seams or wall/door offsets
trigger_or_cause: Using 350 mm housing as active coverage or using oversized pose-only map pixels
consequence: Contamination survives an apparently complete floor scan
proposed_control: Survey true apertures, plan offset passes, mark unobservable edges, report exposure and gaps and independently inspect coverage.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Rasterized aperture/ground-truth comparison, lane and seam challenge, persistent map mask and field comparison.

title: Photon over-subtraction or spectral mismatch
trigger_or_cause: Field spectrum/direction differs from calibration, upper reference contains beta, compensation bias changes in motion
consequence: Missed contamination or excessive false alarms
proposed_control: Train and challenge per-geometry response on separate fields, measure leakage and covariance, gate unqualified backgrounds and retain raw data.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Signed held-out prediction/bias budget and blinded seeded trials; impose field-specific restrictions where needed.

title: Too few counts at scanning speed
trigger_or_cause: Small hotspot, far corner, seam, high reference subtraction noise or insufficient live time
proposed_control: Define minimum hotspot dimensions; measure acquisition and active footprint; derate motion, recount or revise head if sensitivity fails.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Moving blinded tests include worst phase and seam, agreed detection and false alarm bounds, qualified speed and field envelope.

title: Wrong radionuclide, unit or release basis
trigger_or_cause: Confuse Bq/m² and Bq/cm², assume decay-chain equilibrium, choose a transport value for another survey purpose
consequence: Unsafe release interpretation or unnecessary hold
proposed_control: Site-authorized material/purpose profile with units, isotopic basis, averaging area, expiry and sign-off. Disable unknown profile and display scope.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Independent profile review and tests with incorrect calibration, unit mismatch and unknown material; signed site procedure.

title: Cold damage, saturation or unstable bias
trigger_or_cause: Warm-start transient, weak SiPM light yield, cold bond failure, ADC clipping, dew/frost or window leak
consequence: Sensitivity loss masked by a plausible count stream
proposed_control: Monitor local temperature and health, maintain verified bias and thermal control, flag overload; inspect or replace window and recheck reference.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Window integrity and efficiency after climatic cycling, gain/crosstalk and mixed-field qualification after each relevant change.

title: Heater or battery fault, brownout or regenerative charging in cold
trigger_or_cause: Open/short control, worst loads, cold limited battery, brake energy exceeds BMS acceptance
consequence: Fire, upset counts, loss of supervision or stranded robot
proposed_control: Independent thermal cutout, fused branches, pack-rated charging inhibit, recovery reserve, current/temperature logging, safe stop.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Fault-injection scope and power traces, measured duty cycle/pack limits and reserve verified in full mission.

title: Localization ambiguity or time misalignment
trigger_or_cause: Repetitive walls, drifting odometry, sensor lag, late or duplicate data after reset
consequence: Hotspot assigned to the wrong location or a gap filled with stale data
proposed_control: Geometry manifest and time epochs, fusion and quality checks, feet-on-ground references, timestamp mapping and bounded extrapolation.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Ground-truth pose/tag/time challenge, deterministic replay and flagged discontinuities; restrict geometry with degeneracy.

title: Floor contamination spread during retrieval/service
trigger_or_cause: Dirt-trapping print, dragged window, loosened removable cassette, transport in clean vehicle
consequence: Personnel, wheels or clean areas contaminated
proposed_control: Use wipeable surfaces and guards, trays and controlled service/clean workflow, restrict access and cap sensitive surfaces.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Tracer cleaning trial, wipe/inspection signed by site RP; assessed packaging and head-change cleaning steps.

title: Missing raw data or overly confident map
trigger_or_cause: Process failure, storage exhaustion, default-zero fields, filtering signed estimates or displaying interpolated estimates as observations
proposed_control: Append local raw records, checkpoint/epoch logic, gap/quality masks, live-time and confidence reporting. Preserve versions for review.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Power interruption and archive replay test with reproducible maps, exclusions, signed estimates and immutable run identity.

title: Optics do not fit or meet vendor quotation assumptions
trigger_or_cause: Catalog probe form factor, passive carrier, tight guides and reference may not fit in a two-plane stack
consequence: Mass growth, procurement delay or poor far-edge response
proposed_control: Order one full-size pair after section drawing review. Keep dummy head available; check moment, heater, window and BOM allowance.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Actual section/width, cold stability and response raster approved before multi-unit commitment and charged-particle leakage measured.

title: Contact or trapping near a shared-space scan or guided target
trigger_or_cause: A worker steps near the moving head, a protruding corner enters an aisle pinch point, an obscured foot is missed or a stale Next is replayed during marking.
consequence: Unexpected motion, contact or personnel exposed at a door.
proposed_control: Size the monitored moving envelope around all protrusions and all allowed motion for the approach speed, latency and measured braking. Verify coverage, motion supervisor and stop path. Restrict any unprotectable route. Keep drive inhibited for close work. Log one operator command per leg.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Surrogate leg and crossing trials with cold/wet floor and full payload; verify no compression against the wall and adequate escape space. Follow with approved supervised shared-space scan/Next trials, protective-fault and duplicate-command tests.

title: Cantilever bounce or concentrated obstacle penetrates central aperture
trigger_or_cause: Rough floor, head inertia, low battery ballast or narrow debris misses a peripheral bumper.
consequence: Damaged entrance film, carryover contamination or wrong Bq/cm² from unqualified gap.
proposed_control: Measure support reactions, use stiff chassis load path and independently compliant protective rail; protect interior with characterized grille, inspect trailer and window, record invalid data after impacts.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Instrumented loaded cold-floor trials, fine-debris challenge and post-impact response check. Revise structure or operating envelope if gaps exceed calibration.

title: Live or cold battery swap or motion while charging
trigger_or_cause: Incorrect pack key/latch, charger attached during a start command or concurrent electronics power defeats charge termination.
consequence: Electrical damage, pack fault, connector loading, uncontrolled motion or lost logs.
proposed_control: Use load isolation, positive retention, defined charger power path and charger-present hardware drive inhibit. Monitor pack limits and checkpoint before swapping.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Gloved swap, state transition, charger-termination, charge port strain-relief, reverse insertion and cold-charge tests.

title: Misidentified head or extension treated as field cassette
trigger_or_cause: Stale connection/head association after disconnect, swap or reset; malformed descriptor, calibration mismatch, bench harness mistaken for a seated head or excessive harness drop/noise.
consequence: Collision from wrong envelope, false coverage or incorrect activity estimates.
proposed_control: Read identity and the approved descriptor at handshake and bind raw records on the host. Invalidate that binding on continuity loss, discard stale replies and re-handshake before using further counts. Check physical retention independently. Permit detached bench acquisition only with local traction inhibit.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Record known, rejected, same-head reattachment and changed-head handshakes, reset, old-reply rejection, and count-frame captures. Preserve extension fault, voltage and noise evidence.
